normalisation: ICBHI (source 0) statistics, built into the graph
preprocessing: 1 s windows at 16 kHz, int16 scale; exact 100-3900 Hz band cut and -20 dBFS RMS levelling per window; features as in scripts/fusion.py, rounded to float16
evaluation: 5-fold patient CV on all 126 ICBHI patients: 40.0% balanced accuracy (95% CI 35.9-43.5), children 56.3% (results/cv-results.md). Not tested on Resondi device audio.
